data.narrative:
Windborne is a Series A climate and energy company founded by John Dean that has raised $23.4M to date. The comparable universe in Climate & Energy includes 1 public company (LNZA) and 8 private peers, though same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables were insufficient in number to support a median peer valuation method—the narrow filter yielded fewer than the 3 datapoints required for statistical reliability.

Given the constrained comp set, valuation relies on stage-progression methodology. Using total capital raised ($23.4M) as a proxy for entry valuation, a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-subsequent-round step-ups implies an enterprise value of $47M. This method is the sole quantitative anchor available given peer set limitations.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $40M to $54M, with a median point of $47M. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the 2.0x multiplier in a capital-intensive, pre-revenue frontier-tech sector where risk profiles and burn dynamics may differ materially from stage-based norms. A broader peer dataset at equivalent stage and similar technology maturity would strengthen conviction in this range.
